features.description: Consumes a Kafka topic, tracking offsets and leader epochs.
Accepts records over HTTP, with optional HMAC signature checks.
Consumes a websocket stream, reconnecting on drop.
Publishes result rows to a Kafka topic.
Inserts result batches into a ClickHouse table.
Appends result batches to an Iceberg table through a catalog.
Writes result batches as parquet files to a local path.
Runs a SQL command against the pipeline's own DuckDB connection.
Writes result rows to stdout as JSON.
Retries a sink whose destination is not answering, bounded by a deadline.
Infers a schema per batch and runs the query in memory.
Infers a schema per batch, staging the batch on disk.
Binds a declared schema, ingesting through Arrow.
Window state and the offsets that produced it commit together.
Kafka positions are stored in DuckDB and resumed on restart.
A damaged state file fails the start rather than silently resetting.
SIGTERM writes the buffered batch before exiting.
The process exit status carries the error code a supervisor reads.
Accumulates a batch, flushes it, and commits in that order.
Every failure carries a class.domain.reason code.
Policy RAISE stops the pipeline on a bad record.
Policy IGNORE drops a bad record and keeps the pipeline running.
Policy DLQ diverts a bad record to a sink instead of dropping it.
Publishes and deletes closed windows on an interval.
Renders a config through Jinja2 against SQLFLOW_ environment variables.
Validates a config against the schema and reports where it is wrong.
Exports pipeline counters and histograms over Prometheus.
Serves ad-hoc SQL against the live DuckDB connection.
Resolves the config path and message limits from either flag form.
Runs a pipeline against a fixture file, without a source.
